title: Moonlight 13 — The Answer He Wanted
description: A question over lunch. Hyun reads the instructor, chooses his words, and discovers an easy way to win approval.
script:

ambience hall

I: 一口，再一口。我的手好像只会做这一件事了。
I: 肚子终于舒服了，手却还不想停。

Hyun.name: 李贤 · Lee Hyun
Hyun.provenance: Approved Hyun B and expression refinement, imagegen concept references 2026-10-14. Translated by hand into articulated SVG: angular cheeks, layered hair, family warmth and eager reward expressions. Original fictional interpretation, not official art.

Instructor.name: 教官 · Instructor
Instructor.provenance: Original fictional Training Hall instructor, shared polished SVG character; not official artwork.

Dummy.name: 稻草人 · Training dummy
Dummy.provenance: Original hand-authored vector straw training dummy rendered to transparent WebP. Inanimate standalone stage character. Paired choreography moves its whole body; no human facial or limb rig.

Watcher.name: 旁边的人 · Onlooker
Watcher.provenance: Original fictional passing player for LMS episode 7; shared polished SVG rig, not official art.

Pluto.name: 普鲁托 · Pluto
Pluto.provenance: Original fictional Pluto from the supplied Moonlight Sculptor scene. Polished SVG with silver and gold tunic styling; the source's plate armor is described, not a new articulated armor model. Not official artwork.

sources: The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Book 1, Chapter 2 — adapted from the supplied EPUB. Sculpture Mastery conversation over lunch; stops before the moonlight-carving rumor. Choices change attention and delivery, not canonical events.

我还在教官旁边吃午饭。.english: I am still eating lunch beside the instructor.
我还在教官旁边吃午饭。.pinyin: wǒ hái zài jiào guān páng biān chī wǔ fàn 。

一口，再一口。我的手好像只会做这一件事了。.english: One mouthful, then another. My hand seems to know only this one job now.
一口，再一口。我的手好像只会做这一件事了。.pinyin: yì kǒu ， zài yì kǒu 。 wǒ de shǒu hǎo xiàng zhǐ huì zuò zhè yí jiàn shì le 。

肚子终于舒服了，手却还不想停。.english: My stomach finally feels comfortable, but my hand still does not want to stop.

interlinear.gloss: still does not want to stop.

肚子终于舒服了，手却还不想停。.pinyin: dù zi zhōng yú shū fu le ， shǒu què hái bù xiǎng tíng 。

对了，你觉得雕刻怎么样？.english: By the way, what do you think of sculpture?
对了，你觉得雕刻怎么样？.pinyin: duì le ， nǐ jué de diāo kè zěn me yàng ？

我的手停了。雕刻？那是什么？.english: My hand stopped. Sculpture? What is that?
我的手停了。雕刻？那是什么？.pinyin: wǒ de shǒu tíng le 。 diāo kè ？ nà shì shén me ？

先把嘴里的饭吃完，再说话。.english: Finish the food in my mouth first, then speak.
先把嘴里的饭吃完，再说话。.pinyin: xiān bǎ zuǐ lǐ de fàn chī wán ， zài shuō huà 。

您说的雕刻，是一种做东西的本事吗？.english: Is the sculpture you mentioned a skill for making things?

interlinear.pinyin: zuò dōng xi de běn shi ma ？

您说的雕刻，是一种做东西的本事吗？.pinyin: nín shuō de diāo kè ， shì yì zhǒng zuò dōng xi de běn shi ma ？

我只是想听听，你觉得这种本事怎么样？.english: I just want to hear what you think of this skill.
我只是想听听，你觉得这种本事怎么样？.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng tīng ting ， nǐ jué de zhè zhǒng běn shi zěn me yàng ？

怎么会问这个？我还不知道要怎么说。.english: Why ask this? I still do not know what to say.
怎么会问这个？我还不知道要怎么说。.pinyin: zěn me huì wèn zhè ge ？ wǒ hái bù zhī dào yào zěn me shuō 。

等等，先想一想。.pinyin: děng děng ， xiān xiǎng yi xiǎng 。

我不说话，心里却一下子想了很多。.english: I say nothing, but all at once my mind is full of thoughts.
我不说话，心里却一下子想了很多。.pinyin: wǒ bù shuō huà ， xīn lǐ què yí xià zi xiǎng le hěn duō 。

想想教官怎么看剑。.english: Think about how the instructor views swords.
想想教官怎么看剑。.pinyin: xiǎng xiang jiào guān zěn me kàn jiàn 。

想想教官怎么看练习。.english: Think about how the instructor views practice.
想想教官怎么看练习。.pinyin: xiǎng xiang jiào guān zěn me kàn liàn xí 。

在他心里，剑比什么都好。.english: In his mind, the sword is better than anything.
在他心里，剑比什么都好。.pinyin: zài tā xīn lǐ ， jiàn bǐ shén me dōu hǎo 。

他觉得，有了剑，什么事都可以做好。.english: He thinks that with a sword, anything can be done well.
他觉得，有了剑，什么事都可以做好。.pinyin: tā jué de ， yǒu le jiàn ， shén me shì dōu kě yǐ zuò hǎo 。

他最喜欢看人认真练习。.english: He loves watching people practice seriously.
他最喜欢看人认真练习。.pinyin: tā zuì xǐ huan kàn rén rèn zhēn liàn xí 。

练得越认真，他就越开心。.english: The more seriously you practice, the happier he is.
练得越认真，他就越开心。.pinyin: liàn de yuè rèn zhēn ， tā jiù yuè kāi xīn 。

这三个星期，我已经看明白了。.english: Over these three weeks, I have come to understand him.
这三个星期，我已经看明白了。.pinyin: zhè sān gè xīng qī ， wǒ yǐ jīng kàn míng bai le 。

他想的事情很简单，眼里几乎只有剑。.english: His thinking is simple. He sees almost nothing but the sword.

interlinear.gloss: there is almost only the sword.

他想的事情很简单，眼里几乎只有剑。.pinyin: tā xiǎng de shì qing hěn jiǎn dān ， yǎn lǐ jī hū zhǐ yǒu jiàn 。

这样的人，为什么现在问我雕刻呢？.english: Why would someone like him ask me about sculpture now?
这样的人，为什么现在问我雕刻呢？.pinyin: zhè yàng de rén ， wèi shén me xiàn zài wèn wǒ diāo kè ne ？

我看了看教官，知道要怎么说了。.english: I look at the instructor and know what to say.
我看了看教官，知道要怎么说了。.pinyin: wǒ kàn le kàn jiào guān ， zhī dào yào zěn me shuō le 。

别在这种事上花时间。.english: Do not spend time on this sort of thing.

interlinear.gloss: Do not, on this sort of thing,
interlinear.pinyin: bié zài zhè zhǒng shì shàng

别在这种事上花时间。.pinyin: bié zài zhè zhǒng shì shàng huā shí jiān 。

我可是用剑的人。.english: I am a man of the sword, after all.
我可是用剑的人。.pinyin: wǒ kě shì yòng jiàn de rén 。

他一定只想把时间用在练习上。.english: He surely wants to spend his time only on practice.
他一定只想把时间用在练习上。.pinyin: tā yí dìng zhǐ xiǎng bǎ shí jiān yòng zài liàn xí shàng 。

他一定想听我说，剑是最重要的。.english: He surely wants to hear me say the sword is most important.
他一定想听我说，剑是最重要的。.pinyin: tā yí dìng xiǎng tīng wǒ shuō ， jiàn shì zuì zhòng yào de 。

教官，您怎么会问这种问题？.english: Instructor, how could you ask such a question?
教官，您怎么会问这种问题？.pinyin: jiào guān ， nín zěn me huì wèn zhè zhǒng wèn tí ？

我让自己看起来很不开心。教官却还在等我说完。.english: I make myself look very unhappy. The instructor is still waiting for me to finish.

interlinear.gloss: is still waiting for me to finish.
interlinear.pinyin: hái zài děng wǒ shuō wán 。

我让自己看起来很不开心。教官却还在等我说完。.pinyin: wǒ ràng zì jǐ kàn qǐ lai hěn bù kāi xīn 。 jiào guān què hái zài děng wǒ shuō wán 。

我可是用剑的人！.english: I am a man of the sword!
我可是用剑的人！.pinyin: wǒ kě shì yòng jiàn de rén ！

雕刻这种小本事，也要我去想吗？.english: You want me to think about a minor skill like sculpture?

interlinear.pinyin: diāo kè zhè zhǒng xiǎo běn shi ，

雕刻这种小本事，也要我去想吗？.pinyin: diāo kè zhè zhǒng xiǎo běn shi ， yě yào wǒ qù xiǎng ma ？

我从来没有想过，一次也没有！.english: I have never thought about it, not even once!
我从来没有想过，一次也没有！.pinyin: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu xiǎng guò ， yí cì yě méi yǒu ！

教官不但没生气，还开心地拍手。.english: Far from getting angry, the instructor claps happily.
教官不但没生气，还开心地拍手。.pinyin: jiào guān bú dàn méi shēng qì ， hái kāi xīn de pāi shǒu 。

我就知道，你一定会这么说！.english: I knew you would say that!
我就知道，你一定会这么说！.pinyin: wǒ jiù zhī dào ， nǐ yí dìng huì zhè me shuō ！

啊，说对了。他真的爱听这个。.english: Ah, that was the right answer. He really loves hearing this.
啊，说对了。他真的爱听这个。.pinyin: ā ， shuō duì le 。 tā zhēn de ài tīng zhè ge 。

刚才想到他眼里只有剑，真的没错。.english: I was right to think that he sees only the sword.

interlinear.pinyin: tā yǎn lǐ zhǐ yǒu jiàn ，

刚才想到他眼里只有剑，真的没错。.pinyin: gāng cái xiǎng dào tā yǎn lǐ zhǐ yǒu jiàn ， zhēn de méi cuò 。

刚才想到他最喜欢看人练习，真的没错。.english: I was right to think that he loves watching people practice.
刚才想到他最喜欢看人练习，真的没错。.pinyin: gāng cái xiǎng dào tā zuì xǐ huan kàn rén liàn xí ， zhēn de méi cuò 。

那种东西，我们想都不用想。.english: We need not even think about that sort of thing.
那种东西，我们想都不用想。.pinyin: nà zhǒng dōng xi ， wǒ men xiǎng dōu bú yòng xiǎng 。

连一点时间都不要花在上面！.english: We should not spend even a moment on it!
连一点时间都不要花在上面！.pinyin: lián yì diǎn shí jiān dōu bú yào huā zài shàng miàn ！

我们用剑的人，为什么要想那种事？.english: Why should we people of the sword think about that?

interlinear.pinyin: wǒ men yòng jiàn de rén ，

我们用剑的人，为什么要想那种事？.pinyin: wǒ men yòng jiàn de rén ， wèi shén me yào xiǎng nà zhǒng shì ？

说得好！你说的跟我想的一样。.english: Well said! You think just as I do.
说得好！你说的跟我想的一样。.pinyin: shuō de hǎo ！ nǐ shuō de gēn wǒ xiǎng de yí yàng 。

看不见的交情，好像又多了一点。.english: Our invisible bond seems to have grown a little more.

interlinear.pinyin: kàn bú jiàn de jiāo qing ，

interlinear.gloss: to have grown a little more.

看不见的交情，好像又多了一点。.pinyin: kàn bú jiàn de jiāo qing ， hǎo xiàng yòu duō le yì diǎn 。

原来，还可以这样让人喜欢自己。.english: So this is another way to make someone like you.

interlinear.pinyin: ràng rén xǐ huan zì jǐ 。

原来，还可以这样让人喜欢自己。.pinyin: yuán lái ， hái kě yǐ zhè yàng ràng rén xǐ huan zì jǐ 。

不用一起去打仗，也不用花很多时间和钱。.english: No need to fight together, or spend lots of time and money.
不用一起去打仗，也不用花很多时间和钱。.pinyin: bú yòng yì qǐ qù dǎ zhàng ， yě bú yòng huā hěn duō shí jiān hé qián 。

找到他不喜欢的东西，跟着说说它有多不好。.english: Find something he dislikes, and join him in saying how bad it is.

interlinear.pinyin: tā bù xǐ huan de dōng xi ，

找到他不喜欢的东西，跟着说说它有多不好。.pinyin: zhǎo dào tā bù xǐ huan de dōng xi ， gēn zhe shuō shuo tā yǒu duō bù hǎo 。

他就觉得，你和他是一样的人了。.english: Then he feels you are the same kind of person as him.

interlinear.gloss: are the same kind of person.
interlinear.pinyin: shì yí yàng de rén le 。

他就觉得，你和他是一样的人了。.pinyin: tā jiù jué de ， nǐ hé tā shì yí yàng de rén le 。

教官笑得很开心。我也跟着笑了。.english: The instructor smiles happily. I smile along with him.
教官笑得很开心。我也跟着笑了。.pinyin: jiào guān xiào de hěn kāi xīn 。 wǒ yě gēn zhe xiào le 。

可是，雕刻到底是什么？我还是不知道。.english: But what exactly is sculpture? I still do not know.

interlinear.pinyin: wǒ hái shì bù zhī dào 。

可是，雕刻到底是什么？我还是不知道。.pinyin: kě shì ， diāo kè dào dǐ shì shén me ？ wǒ hái shì bù zhī dào 。
